# `Browser.NetworkInfo`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.Browser.NetworkInfo — read network-information hints over `Ipe.Ffi.Js` ports.

A first-party proof of the per-capability web mechanism spanning BOTH port
directions: an outbound `JsCmd` requests the hints (`info` one-shot or a
continuous `watch`), and an inbound `JsMsg` carries the reply — a decoded `Info`
or a typed unavailability. Both cross the same seal codec and fail-closed port
discipline as every other port; there is no second transport.

Importing this reserved `Ipe.Browser.<Api>` module discloses
`js-port:network-info` (import-derived, keyed on the canonical
`Ipe.Browser.NetworkInfo` path prefix via `WebCapability::for_browser_module`,
alias-immune); only the top-level app's `[capabilities] accepts` set can grant it.

The two layers:

  * `Ipe.Browser.NetworkInfo.Internals` publishes the closed outbound/inbound ADTs.
  * this module is the high-level layer: `info` returns a `Task Error Info` via
    the correlated port→Task bridge; `watch` is `Cmd`-shaped, and `changes` is
    the inbound subscription folding the narrow `JsMsg` into a typed
    `Result Error Info`. The inbound `case` is EXHAUSTIVE: an unavailability
    becomes a typed `Err`, never a silently dropped variant.

## `Info`

A network-information hint snapshot. Every field is a browser estimate, not a
guarantee.

  * `effectiveType` — the connection class (`"slow-2g"` / `"2g"` / `"3g"` /
    `"4g"`).
  * `downlink` — estimated downlink bandwidth, in megabits per second.
  * `rtt` — estimated round-trip time, in milliseconds.
  * `saveData` — the user's data-saver preference.

## `info`

```ipe
info : Task Error Info
```

`info` — read the current network-information hints ONCE, as a
`Task Error Info`.

Uses the correlated port→Task bridge (`Js.request`). The reply — an `Info` or a
typed unavailability — resolves the `Task` directly; no companion subscription
is needed.

Importing this module discloses `js-port:network-info`; the app must grant it
with `accepts = [ JsPort NetworkInfo ]` under [capabilities] in package.ipe.

## `watch`

```ipe
watch : Cmd.Cmd msg
```

`watch` — begin a CONTINUOUS hint stream; each `change` event delivers a fresh
reading on the `changes` subscription. Outbound `Cmd`.

## `changes`

```ipe
changes : (Result Error Info -> msg) -> Sub.Sub msg
```

`changes toMsg` — the inbound subscription, wired in `subscriptions`.

The decoder IS the security gate: every inbound value runs through the total,
bounded seal decoder for the narrow `JsMsg`; a malformed / mismatched frame is
dropped whole. A decoded `JsMsg` is folded EXHAUSTIVELY into a
`Result Error Info` — a `Reading` becomes `Ok`, an unavailability a typed `Err`.
